item.title: Charlieplexing
item.description: Charlieplexing is a multiplexing technique that allows the control of the largest number of elements (usually LEDs) with the smallest number of microcontroller I/O pins. It takes advantage of the bidirectional property of most such I/O pins and the unidirectional nature of LEDs.
